description:
The generated manifest of an authored Charter Pack (pack-manifest.yaml), in the sanitized shape of ADR-0043.

It lists the pack's constituent artifact files and presets with a content hash each, and a hash over the whole. The hashes are derived fields: a whole-pack write recomputes them from the bytes it writes, the reader does not check them, and the round-trip gate verifies them. Membership is carried as written. The fetched-pack and charter-bundle variants are not this shape.

manifest_hash.description: Derived: SHA-256, lower hex, of the UTF-8 bytes of the RFC 8785 canonical JSON of this manifest without manifest_hash.
